decision.conclusion: 本轮新增正式试验限额3次（10/11/12）已用完，三次均未达公共95%，也未提高历史修复09的56.338896%覆盖。按用户限制停止GBP2优化，不再测试或修改算法。当前配置下GBP2存在明显覆盖停滞，不作为Scene4达95%的成功基线。
decision.deployment_text: 已恢复历史修复09的可追溯已测试配置（前沿0.01、名义高度0.456m），原生源码及两库仍与09一致；该配置仍明确标为未达95%。全部候选before/after、失败数据和校准依据保留，不将较差候选作为默认性能优化。
decision.interpretation: 本轮证据显示两种失效表现：低阈值保留残余三维收益，局部往返且全局回退受阻；提高至3%/10%后则在约40%覆盖时耗尽合格前沿并返航。几何名义高度校准虽缩小平地参考高度差，本次覆盖仍只有28.5350%，没有解决停滞；单次结果不能证明该校准在所有条件下必然降低性能。原生3D收益、前沿资格和全局回退与二维公共完整覆盖不等价。工程上按当前Scene4适配不足归档；这些有限观测不能证明GBP2在所有此类场景理论上都无法成功，也不能排除尚未核实的适配因素。
decision.next_step: 不再启动1.5%阈值、复测、地图重放或新源码优化。仅完成离线结果整理、交接及私有备份；保留STGPlanner/TARE/FAEL已成功基线与GBP2未达标对照。今后若用户另行明确恢复，必须先设新的有限次数和停止条件，不能自动扩展本轮限制。

geometry.scope: Robot geometry calibration only. Actual GBP2 odometry input is the sensor frame, so its nominal height above ground differs from sensor-to-base offset. No exploration targets or common coverage input. TSDF projection quantization and slopes remain separate errors.

scope: A follow-up of native parameter/geometry adaptation, not a replacement of preselected four-algorithm baseline or five repeated paper statistics.

offline_revisit_diagnostics.scope: Offline association only. Chosen native leaf is not necessarily the truncated executed action endpoint. Legitimate global backtracking can revisit old poses. A near-old pose does not prove previously complete sensor visibility. Homing return and post-native-end hold excluded; area growth never fed back into the planner. No historical native map/gain reconstruction.

height_reference_validation.scope: Nominal conversion at median projected flat roots versus independent sensor-odometry snapshots on the same flat floor. Snapshots are not temporally paired with every selected root. Does not establish all sample/cluster gain origins or sensor angles are exact, and does not establish exploration performance improvement. Residual ground-projection/voxel quantization remains.
